On the opposite side on margin of a copy of Msgr. Edw. Casey's letter to Fr. Solanus of January 12, 1936 Fr. Solanus added in his handwritting the following:
I am not sure if I sent you a copy of this letter some years ago or not. At all events I hope you like it. With my own it makes a double letter - worth while I hope.
Fr. Solanus
